descriptionChirho: In the Nifal stem, to experience shame or public disgrace, whether as an internal emotional state of being ashamed or as the condition of being publicly humiliated and disgraced.
In the Hifil stem, to cause shame or humiliation to another person, actively disgracing, insulting, or putting someone to shame.
In the Hofal stem (passive of Hifil), to be caused shame or humiliation by an external agent, emphasizing that the disgrace was inflicted rather than simply experienced.
